gender.Description: Gender as recorded on the study form

tcre_size_mm.Description: Outer diameter of the tripolar concentric ring electrodes

electrodes_per_array.Description: Number of TCRE electrodes in each array, in the order F4/P6/F3/P5

eog_channels.Description: Channel numbers (1-based) of the two EOG channels, recorded with two standard disc electrodes (not TCREs) placed above and to the right of one eye; labelled EOG in channels.tsv. n/a = no EOG electrodes

run_order.Description: Condition of runs 1-4 (one condition per run of 50 trials), one letter per run: O = overt run (pictures named aloud), C = covert run (pictures named silently); e.g. OCCO = overt, covert, covert, overt
